Hi! I found what seems to be a bug with the Potion Bottle Goal Widget.

After testing in both OBS Studio and Meld Studio, I discovered that the issue is caused by the particle effects.

If particles are enabled, even with only one bottle in a clean overlay, my alerts freeze and my camera starts losing FPS. If I disable the particles, everything works correctly, even with multiple goal bottles in the same overlay.

I just wanted to let you know in case this helps identify the issue. Is there an updated version or a fix for the particle effects?

Also, as a small suggestion, it would be great if the water movement speed could be set even slower. Even at the lowest available setting, it still looks a little too fast for my preference.

Thank you!
